name: Inspect & Repair Primed Ceiling
intent: After ceiling primer cures, inspect for defects revealed by primer (telegraphing seams, fastener pops, mud blemishes), spackle them, sand the spackle flush, spot-prime repairs, and vacuum dust before finish coats. QT2 skips this module entirely; QT3-5 all run it with rates that scale by tier scrutiny.
doctrine: Ceiling inspection rates (1200 / 800 / 500 SF/hr) are slower than wall inspection rates at every QT because of the overhead viewing angle. Spackle and sand rates are also slower per SF. Spot prime and vacuum stay flat across QT because they're mechanical actions. The premium-tier slowdown is primarily in the inspection step where the painter is hunting for finer defects under stronger light.
